verdict.rationale: HumanLayer suggests you can see agent sessions remotely: a remote-daemon task can be controlled from app.humanlayer.com on a computer or phone, and automation runs produce "Cloud-visible" coding sessions. Slack can also receive task artifact updates. None of the evidence explicitly describes a live activity stream or a current-status indicator for a running agent. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a real-time agent activity view, a session/agent status display, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
